# Independent audit of free middle-face tents and the Green interface

Source: `candidate 929f9f6bc9acea34`.
All four sections pass, with their stated proper or strictly saturated
A-cut hypothesis. Supporting saturated A cuts are not silently included
in its differentiable Jacobian argument.

The middle-only enlargement preserves midpoint compatibility by
inclusion. The previously established general face-bulge formula has
an o(e) remainder, which suffices. Original proper middle cuts either
cross the thin added band transversely or remain a positive distance
from it. Thus their added-cap Lipschitz constants tend to zero and
the inverse-map fixed point is legitimate. The fixed strict A statuses
are locally constant; proper A slices have continuous densities.

The inverse-section weighted sum cancels the one actual source motion.
The middle traces cover all points, so the rising common menu bounds
every new middle source. Its positive derivative makes it exceed both
fixed endpoint maxima, even if both were tied. Division by the true
increased mass gives exactly the face-tent cost. No actual endpoint
gap or compatible-room hypothesis is needed in this particular path.

The Dirichlet Green kernel on [alpha,beta] has -d^2/dt^2 equal to
the identity on bounded piecewise-constant densities and zero endpoint
values. Its relation to the unit-height tent contains exactly the
factor (beta-alpha)/[(t-alpha)(beta-t)]. Thus nonnegative tent costs
are equivalent to U>=0, with U'(alpha)>=0 and U'(beta)<=0.

For a signed trapezoid roof H, integration by parts gives

    integral H f=H(alpha)U'(alpha)-H(beta)U'(beta)
                    -integral H'' U.

Substituting its endpoint values and its two negative slope-jump atoms
gives the source's equation(6), including its signs and the coincident
peak case c=d. The formula retains real outer-layer removal. It does
not convert U>=0 into the false pointwise statement f>=0.

The exact example is also verified. With T={v_i.x<=1}, |T|=9/2,
A=(3/5)T, K=-T, B=(4/5)(-T), their areas are81/50,9/2,72/25
and their sum is9. The support calculation
h_A(-v_i)+h_B(-v_i)=6/5+4/5=2 verifies actual compatibility.
The inclusion -A subset B supplies the measure-preserving reflected
endpoint pairs for every ambient through-source halfspace. The own
simplex contribution is2. The three explicit caps attain raw mass
181/50 and cover all middle sources. Both isolated endpoint maxima
are smaller, so this is the actual global maximum, not merely a
fixed-source lower bound.

The A cuts are strictly full and locally constant. All three K section
coefficients are2, giving equal weights1/3. Along each K edge the
singleton/pair/singleton pattern has transition parameters1/3 and2/3.
The source's elementary tent integrals show central probability at
least1/3 and therefore mean load at least4/9. Its gap over181/450 is
19/450, proving every tent cost positive despite low outer loads.
The example has depth above the OC target and is explicitly presented
only as a counterexample to a pointwise inference from tent positivity.

Result: PASS for the actual local theorem, Green identity, and exact
scoped obstruction. No assertion of a general extremizer is involved.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
